title: AI RAG Clean Markdown Extractor Input

start_urls.title: Start URLs or Sitemaps
start_urls.description: List of web page URLs or sitemap XML links (e.g. https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/index.html).

chunk_size.title: RAG Chunk Size (approx. characters)
chunk_size.description: Target character count per RAG chunk (approx. 4 characters = 1 token). Default 1600 (~400 tokens).

chunk_overlap.title: RAG Chunk Overlap (characters)
chunk_overlap.description: Character overlap between consecutive chunks to preserve contextual coherence.

max_pages.title: Max Pages to Process
max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to process from sitemaps or URL lists.

generate_llms_txt.title: Generate llms.txt Draft
generate_llms_txt.description: When true, generates a ready-to-use standardized llms.txt specification file draft for the domain.
